title: Seymour Mann Connoisseur Collection Porcelain Doll TEC-502 1995 W/ COA
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText:
Seymour Mann "Connoisseur Collection" porcelain doll, Style No. TEC-502, hand-painted porcelain head/arms/legs with hand-finished floral dress, lace trim, and glass eyes. Limited edition of 7,500, individually numbered Certificate of Authenticity included, plus the original Doll Collectors Guild tag.
Comes with doll-sized glasses and a small book accessory. ©1995 (MCMXCV), handcrafted exclusively for Seymour Mann Inc.
New, never displayed — still largely in original wrapping. Box shows some handling wear from storage (see photos).
